briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies AGI race as China closes capability gap

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate releases amid regulatory scrutiny while compute buildouts hit record pace. Multi-agent systems expose new attack surfaces as adoption surges across industries.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek R2 narrowed performance gap to Western models.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft expanded its Stargate cluster to 200k H100s; TSMC reported AI chip demand outstripping supply through 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models overtake closed frontier systems in safety benchmarks by 2027?
